extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “GREAT Golden Protector” is a personal accident insurance product focused on accidents occurring on public transportation or in a private car. It highlights a payout of “up to 300%” and specifies “Receive 3 times the payout upon Accidental Death or Permanent Disablement caused by an accident on public transportation or a private car”. For hospitalisation, it provides “a cash benefit of up to S$200 per day,” and it also states that this hospital cash “covers hospital stays due to Dengue Fever or other Infectious Diseases.” The brochure also mentions a discount feature—“25% off premiums on 2nd life assured”—for Singapore Citizens/PRs when adding a spouse as the 2nd life assured via a financial representative, but this is not the core coverage mechanism.
quality_notes: The brochure content provided is partial and does not include the full Table of Benefits details/amounts.
Many fields required by the schema (e.g., entry ages, exact benefit formulas/limits, benefit waiting periods) are not stated in the provided text.

policies.quick_summary: Personal accident insurance with enhanced payout (3 times) for accidental death/permanent disablement caused by accidents on public transportation or a private car, and hospital cash of up to S$200/day (including dengue and other infectious diseases). Discount for adding a spouse as 2nd life assured via financial representative is also mentioned (25% off premiums). Based on provided brochure excerpts only; full terms not included here—values in table appear incomplete in the excerpted content provided to this system output format context. See evidence quotes for what is extractable from the supplied text.
coverage_scope: Accidental Death caused by an accident on public transportation or a private car
Permanent Disablement caused by an accident on public transportation or a private car
Hospitalisation cash benefit up to S$200 per day (including dengue fever or other infectious diseases)
policies.residency_requirements: Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents (PRs); if not a Singapore Citizen or PR, must meet certain residency requirements before applying or renewing.
policies.eligibility_notes: All ages specified refer to age next birthday.
policy_termination_events: Policy may be terminated in accordance with the free-look provision (if any) after purchasing the policy
important_caveats: 25% family discount on premiums on 2nd life assured is exclusive and only available when signing up via a financial representative; not valid for online application.
The brochure states that it is protected up to specified limits by SDIC.
